decisions.reason: The source changes post-mint modal wording only; the book title and reward terms overlap incidentally and do not require changes to the About page.
The new wording applies to post-distribution mint-success feedback, not the validity rules or blank/invalid-code validation feedback.
Mentioning the book title in the success modal does not change certificate delivery, contents, reading actions, or link labels.
The source describes the already-established random $5 allocation as completed but changes only the modal wording and its use condition.
The client specifies text for a post-mint modal and does not direct any corresponding FAQ revision.
The source presupposes ticket distribution but does not change ticket counts, counters, associations, backfill, or display consistency.
The modal copy does not alter commission accounting totals, projection surfaces, consistency rules, or backfill policy.
The source reports completed random ticket distribution only as the condition for wording; it does not change the allocation trigger, recipient, count, exception, or finalization rule.
The source concerns a mint with no referral code and therefore does not change code-used referral commission behavior.
References to a $5 commission and $500 ticket describe feedback content and do not modify the $15 price or revenue allocation.
The source contains no decision about Transak, wallet creation, custody, seed phrases, wallet holdings, or buyer access paths.
The post-mint modal wording does not change NFT metadata fields, reward-accounting attributes, counters, badges, or consistency requirements.
